title: Build your own knowledge graph-powered MCP server
description:
Day one of CDL26 starts with a build session. In two hours, Martin O'Hanlon of Neo4j will take you through creating a knowledge graph from your own use case, querying it, wrapping it in an MCP server and connecting an agent to it.

The idea behind it is simple: agents are only as good as the context and tools they are given, and a knowledge graph gives them a structured view of your data to work from.

It's a hands-on workshop, so you'll build each step yourself and leave knowing how to do the same with your organisation's data.

🎤 Martin O'Hanlon, Developer Advocate, Neo4j
 📅 11 November 2026, 09:30 AM - 11:30 AM, Developer Evolution Track (America Suite)
📍 Leonardo Royal Hotel London Tower Bridge
